messages:
erin: heads-up — main pipeline went red right after merge, failing job: integration/embedding-indexer. can someone grab?
ci-bot: job failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 (stage: integration/embedding-indexer)
ci-bot: last log lines: 
```
ERROR: failed to connect to test-db: connection refused
stack: src/storage/connector.rs:412
```
leo: thanks — pinging @nina since the merge was hers. nina: yep that was my merge, i ran unit/local tests but not the full integration matrix. looking now.
samir: could be a transient test-db issue or a teardown race. can we rerun just that job first? avoids full pipeline cost.
erin: rerun would be good. ops-oncall, can you kick the job or give permission?
ops-oncall: i can trigger, doing `ci rerun --job integration/embedding-indexer --sha 8f7a2c3` now.
ci-bot: rerun started: https://ci.internal/redwood/12346
leo: while that's running, can we check if any infra changes hit test-db this hour? nina: nothing from my PR beyond schema tweak but it was guarded. i grep'd the migration and it's fine.
samir: if rerun fails, next step: bisect last 5 merges between HEAD~5..HEAD to find the breaking change. quick bisect commands i use: 
```
git bisect start HEAD HEAD~5
git bisect run ./scripts/ci/integration-runner.sh --job embedding-indexer
```
ci-bot: rerun finished — job succeeded on attempt #1 :thumbsup:
erin: awesome, thanks everyone. nina — can you add a small follow-up to add a pre-merge matrix check for embedding-indexer so we catch this earlier? simple check is fine.
nina: yes, will open a quick PR to add the job to the merge matrix and mark flakiness ticket if it recurs.
leo: leaving a note in the release checklist too. closing here unless it pops up again. :slightly_smiling_face:
